question: According to the World Population Review Report, released in February 2020, the Indian economy emerged as the world's _______ largest economy in 2019.
solution:
The correct answer is __**5th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **World Population Review Report**, released in **February 2020**, the **Indian economy** emerged as the **world's 5th largest economy** in 2019.

 
 
• It **overtook **the **United Kingdom **and **France**.
 
• **India’s economy **is the fifth-largest in the world with a gross domestic product (**GDP**) of **$2.94 trillion**. 
 
• The size of the **UK economy is $2.83** **trillion **and that of **France is $2.71 trillion**. 
 
• In purchasing power parity (PPP), India’s GDP is $10.51 trillion, exceeding that of Japan and Germany.
 
• According to the report,** India’s service sector** is the** fast-growing sector **in the world accounting for **60% of the economy** and 28% of employment.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Top 4 Countries** in the list: 

 
 
• The** US **has been wearing the crown as the **world’s largest economy** for the last 149 years.

 
 
• The nominated GDP of the country stood at $21.44 trillion whereas GDP (PPP) was $21.44 trillion.
 
 
 
• **China is the second-largest **economy in the world and grew at an average of 9.52% between 1989 and 2019.
 
 
• China’s nominal GDP stood at $14.14 trillion.
 
 
 
• With a nominal GDP of $5.15 trillion, **Japan is the third-largest** economy in the world. 
 
• The size of **Germany’s** economy is $4 trillion the **fourth largest **in the world.
